title: Snow load source
description: Woodcore-Datei/loads/snow/<id>.json -- one roof whose characteristic snow loads Woodcore computes from SIA 261:2020 chapter 5 (calc/domains/snow_source.py, docs/domain/loads.md §3.3bis, issue #36). Read beside the SL-* sheets of a load workbook, under the same domain snow-load; an id both carry is refused.

schema_version.description: -- pinned. 1.1 (issue #42): 1.0 with `links`, written only where a field follows a variable. 1.2 (spec 2026-10-12-audit-issues-47-48-49, D-19): 1.1 with `height_step`, written only where the roof has a height step -- a superset of 1.1, links allowed. 1.3 (spec 2026-10-22-onglet-neige-type, REQ-021): 1.2 with a free C_e, `exposure` "custom" and its number `c_e`, written only where the engineer types one -- the versions are floors, a source written at the highest one a field asks.

id.description: The file name without .json, and the instance the report names.

height_step.description: SIA 261 5.3.6: the roof is stepped, or adjoins a taller building -- the report then says that the triangular extra load of Figur 5 applies on the lower roof. Written only when true (schema 1.2); absent is false.

h_0.description: The site's altitude above sea level, m.

correction.description: The correction of the map of SIA 261 Anhang D, m: -200, 0, 200, 400 or 500.

exposure.description: SIA 261 5.2.4: C_e 1.0, 0.8 or 1.2 -- or `custom`, a C_e of the engineer's own in `c_e` (schema 1.3).

c_e.description: A C_e of the engineer's own, above 0, with `exposure` "custom" only (schema 1.3): taken as it is, without a message (spec 2026-10-22-onglet-neige-type, D-10).

c_t.description: C_T, 1.0 unless the roof's heat speeds the melting (5.2.5): above 0 and at most 1.

roof.description: The roof form of SIA 261 Figur 3: flat, mono-pitch (half a duo-pitch, 5.3.2), duo-pitch, shed, curved (the third column).

length.description: The building's length, m: entered for every roof, read by a flat roof only (Figur 4 where both length and width exceed 20 m, 5.3.5).

width.description: The building's width, m: entered for every roof, read by a flat roof only.

alpha_1.description: The slope of a mono-pitch roof, of the first side of a duo-pitch or a shed roof, or the alpha of a curved roof (Figur 3), degrees.

alpha_2.description: The slope of the second side of a duo-pitch or a shed roof, degrees.

sliding.description: SIA 261 5.3.4: hindered (snow guards, a parapet at the eaves) takes mu_1 = 0.8.

links.description: The fields of this entry that follow a variable of the export, by their key (h_0, c_t, length, width, alpha_1, alpha_2): the number the field holds is the last value known, which a variable that can no longer be read leaves in place with a warning (D-06). Absent where none follows one; only at schema_version 1.1.

.*.description: A variable of the export this field follows (calc/domains/links.py, spec 2026-10-11-variables-liees-champs-et-textes D-17): the pair a call names its calculation by and its key -- a domain of the «Formule» tab carries origin "formulas" and its id as instance --, with an optional factor and offset (factor × variable + offset).
